items.excerpt: House/UKG producer Todd Edwards says he now generates his own material in Suno Studio to sample and chop, calling it a co-producer that frees him from sample-clearance lawsuits, and calls industry criticism hypocritical.
items.title: "The hypocrisy in the industry is insane": Todd Edwards on sampling Suno

items.excerpt: Independent publisher bodies IMPF and IMPEL publish a generative-AI licensing framework whose non-negotiable principle is that songs be valued at least equally with recordings, plus transparency on training vs output payments.
items.title: IMPF and IMPEL publish AI licensing principles

items.excerpt: Absolute Label Services opens its AI-powered Anthology 'Music OS' with in-house LLM Ant to indie rights holders; Cherry Red and Blue Raincoat are first customers.
items.title: Absolute opens AI-powered Anthology Music OS

items.excerpt: US Third Circuit upholds that Ross Intelligence's copying of Westlaw material for AI training was not fair use; RIAA and NMPA backed Thomson Reuters, framing it as precedent for Suno/Udio cases.
items.title: Appeals court rejects fair use defense over AI training

items.excerpt: Suno confirms its v6 model was trained on user creations as it calls the latest UMG/Sony lawsuit fundamentally flawed.
items.title: Suno confirms V6 trained on user creations

items.excerpt: Tokyo District Court rules a voice is a protected publicity right in a first-of-its-kind decision, but dismisses voice actor Kenjiro Tsuda's AI-voice takedown request against TikTok.
items.title: Japan rules voice is a protected publicity right

items.excerpt: Questlove traces sampling history and says he sees AI as a parallel to sampling culture, but won't sample AI output yet and calls for transparency and compensation.
items.title: Questlove: 'I see AI as a parallel to sampling culture'

items.excerpt: Suno's official channel shows artist Banoffee using Suno v6 to push her sound somewhere new (45s artist film).
items.title: Watch Banoffee push her sound | Suno v6

items.excerpt: Dancer Braylon Browner uses Suno v6 to turn movement into music (60s artist film).
items.title: Watch Braylon Browner turn a dance into a song | Suno v6

items.excerpt: Andrew Huang short warning that AI scammers are trying to use his identity (21s).
items.title: AI scammers are trying to use me

items.excerpt: Sampleson Backgrounds uses semantic audio retrieval over 22,000 audio cells and 11,000 local embeddings to build evolving soundscapes from keywords dragged onto a canvas; runs locally.
items.title: Backgrounds creates soundscapes from keyword prompts

items.excerpt: Blind organist Solveig-Marie Oma describes the Braille score workflow and where AI note recognition, score conversion and AI vocal guides could help.
items.title: What it takes to read music without sight, and what AI can solve

items.excerpt: Automated AI ad tools and MCP servers linking artist data to AI assistants are reshaping music marketing campaigns.
items.title: Advertising campaigns handled by AI are on the rise
